title: dalbergia lanceolaria var. assamica
intro: Dalbergia lanceolaria var. assamica, commonly known as Indian Blackwood, is a tropical tree species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Indian Blackwood include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects.
